theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_diagonal_mollified_uniform_cauchy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ) (F : ℕ → Set (Rn N)), (∀ m, Continuous (ρ m)) → (∀ m, HasCompactSupport (ρ m)) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ l ≥ k₀, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) m, |(∫ z in F (φ k), ρ m (y - z)) - ∫ z in F (φ l), ρ m (y - z)| ≤ ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
